Initial release of Video Editing With Music Free — Edit Videos With Background Music.

- Edit videos using natural language prompts — no need for complex editing software.
- Download finished videos in 1080p MP4 format, ready for social sharing.
- Includes a free token system with 100 credits for quick, no-cost editing.
- Handles session setup, uploads, exports, and state management automatically in the background.
